import os, numpy as np, pandas as pd
exec(open("work/caplib.py").read()); exec(open("work/caplib2.py").read())
S = build_set()
CD=None
for L in open("work/pdb/Triflin_1WVR.pdb"):
    if L.startswith("HETATM") and L[17:20].strip()=="CD" and int(L[22:26])==301:
        CD=np.array([float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54])])
src=S["Triflin_1WVR"]; A=caof(src); sA=seqof(src)

TETRAD = {"R3HDML_CAP":[("H",108),("Q",119),("E",141),("H",168)],
          "PI15_CAP":[("H",112),("Q",123),("E",145),("H",172)],
          "CRISP2_mature":[("H",82),("E",97),("E",118),("H",136)],
          "Natrin_1XTA":[("H",60),("E",75),("E",96),("H",115)],
          "GAPR1_1SMB":[("H",54),("E",65),("E",86),("H",103)]}
rows=[]
for name,tet in TETRAD.items():
    tgt=S[name]; o=tmalign_fast(A,caof(tgt),sA,seqof(tgt))
    ion=apply_rt(CD[None,:],np.array(o["R"]),np.array(o["t"]))[0]
    idx={int(r["resid"]):r for r in tgt}
    for pos,(aa,rid) in enumerate(tet,1):
        r=idx.get(rid)
        if r is None or r["aa"]!=aa: rows.append(dict(structure=name,position=pos,res="missing",d_min=np.nan)); continue
        pol={an:x for an,x in r["atoms"].items() if an not in ("N","C","CA","O") and an[0] in "NO"}
        if not pol: rows.append(dict(structure=name,position=pos,res="%s%d"%(aa,rid),d_min=np.nan)); continue
        dd={an:float(np.linalg.norm(x-ion)) for an,x in pol.items()}
        best=min(dd,key=dd.get)
        rows.append(dict(structure=name,position=pos,res="%s%d"%(aa,rid),atom=best,d_min=round(dd[best],2)))
A4=pd.DataFrame(rows); A4.to_csv("work/metal_tetrad_arms.csv",index=False)
piv=A4.pivot(index="structure",columns="position",values="d_min")
lab=A4.pivot(index="structure",columns="position",values="res")
print("Distance (A) from the transferred triflin Cd to each tetrad arm's nearest side-chain N/O:\n")
for s in ["Natrin_1XTA","CRISP2_mature","GAPR1_1SMB","PI15_CAP","R3HDML_CAP"]:
    print("%-15s " % s + "  ".join("pos%d %-5s %5.2f"%(p,lab.loc[s,p],piv.loc[s,p]) for p in [1,2,3,4]))

T=pd.read_csv("work/metal_transfer.csv")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
ax=axes[0]
T2=T.sort_values("d1",ascending=False)
cols=["#e53e3e" if n in ("R3HDML_CAP","PI15_CAP") else "#2b6cb0" for n in T2.structure]
ax.barh(T2.structure, T2.d1, color=cols)
ax.axvline(2.2, color="k", ls="--", lw=1)
ax.text(2.25, 0.2, "ideal M2+-N", fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("distance from transferred divalent cation to nearest side-chain N/O (A)")
ax.set_title("A  A cation bound at the triflin CAP tetrad, transferred by superposition,\nlands on a histidine in every CAP protein including R3HDML", fontsize=9, loc="left")
ax=axes[1]
w=0.18
for i,s in enumerate(["Natrin_1XTA","CRISP2_mature","GAPR1_1SMB","PI15_CAP","R3HDML_CAP"]):
    v=[piv.loc[s,p] for p in [1,2,3,4]]
    ax.bar(np.arange(4)+i*w-2*w, v, w, label=s,
           color="#e53e3e" if s in ("R3HDML_CAP","PI15_CAP") else None)
ax.set_xticks(range(4)); ax.set_xticklabels(["pos1 His","pos2 Glu/Gln","pos3 Glu","pos4 His"])
ax.set_ylabel("distance to transferred cation (A)"); ax.legend(fontsize=7)
ax.set_title("B  The two histidine arms are preserved in R3HDML and PI15;\nthe position-2 arm is a glutamine and sits further away", fontsize=9, loc="left")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
